protocol.same_residual_operator: JAX autodifferentiation of u, u_x, u_t, and u_xx for both models
protocol.pca_interpolation: Cubic Hermite interpolation of the training-only PCA mean and modes; PDE derivatives flow through this interpolation with JAX autodiff
protocol.paired_sampling: Same supervised minibatches, residual collocation points, times, initial-condition points, and data partitions for both models within each seed
protocol.timing: Compile and validation-function compilation are performed before timed training and reported separately. Training time includes identical periodic validation evaluations. PCA pipeline time additionally includes PCA fitting.
protocol.pca_data_scope: PCA is fitted only on spatial snapshots at training times; validation and test times are excluded.
